items.title: CISA: Attackers Breach Federal Agency via Critical GeoServer Flaw
items.description: Threat actors exploited CVE-2024-36401 less than two weeks after it was initially disclosed and used it to gain access to a large federal civilian executive branch (FCEB) agency that uses the geospatial mapping data.

items.title: The Fall of Scattered Spider? Teen Member Surrenders Amid Group's Shutdown Claims
items.description: The cybercrime group continues to gain attention despite its apparent shutdown last week.

items.title: New Supermicro BMC flaws can create persistent backdoors

items.title: Russia Targets Moldovan Election in Disinformation Play
items.description: Researchers have tracked a Russian disinformation campaign against upcoming Moldovan elections, linking it to a previous campaign that began in 2022.
